chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Hudhayfah ibn Mansur from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Allah, Exalted and Mighty, revealed the obligation of Hajj upon those with capacity/means every year."
ai.seo_question: Is Hajj obligatory every year for those who can afford it according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) highlights the condition of 'al-jidat' (financial and physical capacity) for the annual obligation of Hajj, a view held by some Shia scholars to distinguish it from the once-in-a-lifetime duty. It underscores the continuous nature of the duty for those who remain capable, linking the ritual to sustained economic ability rather than a single event.
